tools.name: about_wirstartenki
tools.description: Who Felix Schmidt and WirStartenKI are, what the consulting covers and how a first call works.

tools.name: ai_impact_analysis
tools.description: Where AI pays off first in a company. 15 multiple-choice questions: role, size, industry, revenue, biggest cost block, where the time goes, AI use today, data, ownership, know-how, repetitive share, headcount, standardisation, mandate, timing. Returns maturity, impact and momentum scores (0 to 100)

tools.name: get_open_slots
tools.description: Free 15-minute slots for a video call with Felix, live from his calendar. Times are returned in the given IANA time zone and as UTC ISO strings for book_call.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Books one 15-minute video call in an open slot. Only after the person confirmed the time and their e-mail. Google e-mails the invite with the Meet link to that address.

findings.title: Tool renamed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ki_impact_analyse" was renamed to "ai_impact_analysis" (identical description). A rename can slip a tool past name-based review.
